column3: Upon the Terra Apartments Mortgage Loan becoming a specially serviced loan, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the MSBAM 2025-5C2 PSA will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to Terra Apartments Mortgage Loan accruing at a rate equal to the greater of 0.25% per annum and the rate that would result in a special servicing fee for the related month of $5,000.
